notes: Company background: mid-market (SaaS) provider of outbound sales tooling for B2B SMBs; product team wants to add real-time agent chat to help SDRs handle inbound replies and automate calendar/email actions.

Primary objective: replace brittle internal LLM glue with a predictable hosted runtime that can stream responses and trigger tool calls (CRM update, send email, create calendar invite) without perceptible lag for reps.
Latency SLOs: target p95 first-byte <= 300ms for short replies; interactive feel for streaming — prospect wants <200ms ideally for first token in live demo.
Throughput profile: peak concurrency ~180 active reps during EMEA/NA overlap; average message length small (20-60 tokens) but high message rate from bots and humans.
Cost sensitivity: care about per-token unit economics for outbound mass sequences; want guidance on batching vs streaming trade-offs.
Model preferences: open to small/medium open models for most flows, larger (or higher-quality) model for escalation. Interested in quantization and cost/perf profiles for Dedicated.

Tooling needs: robust function/tool-calling examples (calendar invite schema, CRM patch, email send); retry idempotency and observability for tool calls; request tracing for end-to-end latency attribution.

Security notes: must run SAML SSO for all dev accounts; audit logs for every generated message + tool-call; KMS-based key wrapping for any customer-sensitive tokens; data residency for EU customers a hard requirement.
Quote from VP Product on 2026-02-10 call: 'It needs to feel instantaneous to the rep — if it lags they won't trust it.'

Internal red flags: legal wants explicit calendar write rollback policy and indemnity language for automated outbound emails; engineering flagged need for backpressure behavior when downstream CRM API is slow.

POC success criteria (agreed): 1) p95 latency below 350ms for typical requests in hosted test region, 2) successful tool-calls with idempotent retries and no duplicate calendar invites in 500 test runs, 3) clear cost forecast for 6-month ramp to 500k messages/month.
requirements_summary: Hosted-first POC: streaming + function-calling demo. Measure p50/p95 token latency, end-to-end tool-call reliability (CRM/email/calendar). Later evaluate Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation; must support SAML, audit logs, KMS, and EU data residency.
